from itertools import combinations

    sigma_x = Operator.from_matrix([[0, 1], [1, 0]])
    sigma_y = Operator.from_matrix([[0, -1j], [1j, 0]])
    sigma_z = Operator.from_matrix([[1, 0], [0, -1]])
    
    H = Operator(np.zeros((2**num_spins, 2**num_spins), dtype=complex))
    for i in range(num_spins - 1):
        H += J * (sigma_x.tensorpower(i).tensor(sigma_x.tensorpower(num_spins - i - 2)) +
                   sigma_y.tensorpower(i).tensor(sigma_y.tensorpower(num_spins - i - 2)))
        H += Delta * sigma_z.tensorpower(i).tensor(sigma_z.tensorpower(num_spins - i - 2))
    
    return H
